innovation.evidence: Our mission is to help people see data in new ways, discover insights, unlock endless possibilities.

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual navigation and history with few explicit values. The one mission line is aspirational, and the culture and DEI blurbs use hedged belief language like believes and values. Employees and community get the most attention, with stockholders and customers mentioned only briefly. Voice is first-person plural, and the page is dominated by links and chrome.
